rules.title: A negative test is named it_does_not_...
rules.rationale: A suite whose negative tests are named one way and one test another makes the odd one read as a different kind of assertion. The reader of a failure list should be able to tell what did not happen without opening the file.

rules.title: A local read once is inlined unless its name explains something
rules.rationale: A variable assigned and then read exactly once adds a name the reader must carry to the single place it is used. It earns its place only when the name says something the expression does not.

rules.title: A variable is named for what it holds
rules.rationale: A name taken from where a value came from rather than from what it is sends the next reader to the wrong concept. A specification held in a variable called $decision reads as a decision at every later line.

rules.title: Fixture setup repeated across tests is extracted and named
rules.rationale: The same arrangement written out in several tests hides what each test is actually varying. A named helper puts the difference on the line that differs, and the name states the state under test.
